summary: Complete UI testing of Resume Builder redesign. All 25 features tested successfully. Entry page shows compact Upload + Create cards side-by-side. New template selection step works with 5 templates (2 with PRO badges). Editor has 3-panel layout: light sidebar (zinc-50), form workspace (p-8 padding), and live preview. Tips panel is toggleable with Fix All button and compact fix cards showing +points badges. All form tabs (Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras) work correctly with Add/Remove functionality.
passed_tests: Entry page shows compact Upload + Create cards side by side
Upload card opens file picker for .DOCX/.PDF files
Paste text option available on Upload card
Create From Scratch goes to template selection step
Template selection shows 5 templates with PRO badges on Executive and Modern
All 5 templates can be selected (Clean, Professional, Minimal, Executive, Modern)
Continue with [template] button enters the editor
Editor has 3-panel layout: sidebar (left), form (center), preview (right)
Sidebar shows 5 sections (Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras) with icons
Sidebar has light background (zinc-50/50)
Sidebar collapse toggle works
Score displayed in toolbar with ATS/Readability/Impact mini bars
Score widget in sidebar shows score and fix count
Tips toggle button shows fix count badge, opens side panel
Tips panel shows compact fix cards with +points and Fix buttons
Fix All button in tips panel works
Closing tips panel works (via X button)
Personal tab has large form fields (h-14 = 56px) - Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn, Portfolio, Summary
Form area has p-8 padding (32px)
Continue button navigates to next tab, Back button works
Experience tab with Add/Remove, Smart Improve, AI Improve buttons
Education tab with Add/Remove functionality
Skills tab with tag input and skill tags display
Extras tab with certification input
Live Preview always visible on right with Print/PDF buttons
Preview updates as data is entered
Import button in sidebar navigates to entry page
Reset button clears data and returns to entry page
Download PDF button works in toolbar and preview panel
critical_code_review_comments: ResumeBuilder.tsx: Well-structured with clear flow states (entry, processing, review, templates, editor)
Template selection step is a good UX addition between entry and editor
Tips panel as toggleable side panel is cleaner than inline cards
Light sidebar (zinc-50/50) provides good contrast with form area
Form fields consistently use h-14 (56px) for large touch targets
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
Score widget in sidebar provides quick access to resume score
